scope: Public-source acquisition only; no source or route admission

aaron.finding: The actual pack table lists 250mg and 1g, both 80% purity and Global Stock, with positive prices. The exact CAS, graph and formula agree with the frozen stearolic-acid identity. The supplier drawing was visually inspected and agrees.
aaron.indexed_page_discrepancy: Web search for the same URL returned older indexed 50mg and 100mg packs at 98%; those indexed values are not used as current evidence.
aaron.reason: The product page establishes global stock, but the supporting ordering/terms pages do not establish item-specific US fulfillment. The observed 80% grade is retained and is not represented as the prior 99.90% grade.
aaron.nonclaim: No new universal purity threshold is introduced; neither global stock nor a lower grade proves chemical impossibility.

benchchem.finding: The page says In Stock, but its transaction surface requests a quote to obtain pricing and availability. It does not supply item-specific purity or a current US fulfillment observation.

apollo.finding: The stock table has UK/US column headings and no populated pack rows. These headings are not positive inventory evidence.

targetmol.finding: Direct product request returned HTTP 412. Indexed pack rows say Inquiry; the nearby in-stock legend does not qualify availability.

sigma_combiblocks.finding: The public US product request ended without a response. No availability was inferred from the indexed identity listing.

article_review.author_page_finding: Publication 210 has the title, authors, journal pages, abstract, DOI and the same restricted UNIGE repository link; it provides no additional full-text file.
article_review.publisher_metadata_finding: The publisher's public Figshare record contains only jo000463n_si_001.pdf, the already recovered supplement, not the main article.
article_review.remaining_access: An accessible licensed copy of the original main article is required for the outstanding procedure/scheme inspection. No purchase, author contact, credential use, or access-control bypass was performed.
article_review.skill_requirement: Render the cited chemistry pages and neighboring pages to images. Inspect schemes visually.

local_setup_note: An optional BeautifulSoup inspection failed because bs4 is not installed. Standard-library HTML parsing was used instead, without adding a dependency.
